type: 4x4 Collection of the Same Character's Expressions and Micro-Movements
goal: A 4×4 grid within a single image, each cell capturing a moment of Sam Altman's daily developer life in the office, suitable for column illustrations or podcast cover element collage.

subject.description: Sam Altman, Short Hair, Lean, Slightly Relaxed Sitting or Standing Posture, Often Wearing Gray or Deep Blue Round Neck Knit Sweater or Lightweight Jacket
subject.consistency: In the sixteen grids, facial features proportions, hairline, stubble feel are consistent, only the angles of the eyes, eyebrows, mouth, and gestures vary

style: High resolution realistic studio shot + natural top-side soft light, background uniformly light gray wall and oak-colored desktop, with a slightly displaced closed notebook and a cup of black coffee

panels.action: Both hands open palms facing up
Looking down at the laptop screen
Index finger lightly tapping the temple
A coffee cup raised but not yet drunk.

panels.expression: Listening to the other party speaking
panels.action: Head slightly tilted, ear facing out of the frame.
Thumbs up at a low angle.
panels.outfit: Gray pullover + thin jacket draped over the chair back

panels.action: Bowing head with hand over mouth
A single palm lightly pushes forward
Closed laptop, gaze looking at the camera

constraints.must_keep: The sixteen grids depict the same identifiable individual, no face swapping, no exaggerated aging
constraints.avoid: Cell and adjacent cell composition resembles copy-pasting, more than three items on the desktop
